_meta.purpose: The body systems of the health radar, each with the laboratory panel that defines it. Read by engine/lifestyle.py (the laboratory half: score, coverage, dynamics) and by engine/system_panels.py (the genetic half and the questions for a clinician). One file, two readers, so that the two halves of a system cannot drift apart in silence.
_meta.who_writes_this: The project. Which markers a laboratory issues as one panel is reference knowledge, not a medical claim about a person; the composition was decided in 0.4.9 and is not reopened here.
_meta.why_cardio: The thirteenth system, «Heart and vessels», was added on the owner's decision of 13.09.2026 so that the strongest pharmacogenetic pairs — warfarin with VKORC1/CYP2C9/CYP4F2, clopidogrel with CYP2C19, the beta-blockers, the anticoagulants and antiplatelets — and the cardiovascular polygenic scores have a system to stand on. Its laboratory panel is the cardiovascular-risk and coagulation markers a laboratory issues beside, not inside, the lipid panel: lipoprotein(a), apolipoproteins B and A1, fibrinogen, D-dimer. Lipids stay a separate system. The pulse and heart-rate variability the wearable records stay in fitness, because a domain has one source and this one's is the laboratory.
_meta.why_four_endocrine_systems: The endocrine system is not one system. «Hormones» averaged a thyroid marker, a gonadal one and a hepatic one into a single number, and the ring beside it measured how much of that mixture existed — a quantity nobody orders. Thyroid, adrenals, gonads and growth are the panels a laboratory actually issues, and they became four domains in 0.4.9. The composition is not to be changed by a later task: a system with a different marker set is a different system, and every stored radar score before the change would be measured against a panel that no longer exists.
_meta.fitness: The wearables system (the twelfth until 13.09.2026, the thirteenth since — see why_cardio) is not a laboratory panel: it is built from wearable metrics, its markers are whatever the device reports, and `health_radar` attaches it after the laboratory domains. It is listed here with `source: wearables` and `genetic_half: false` so that no reader counts the laboratory domains and loses it, and no reader attaches a genetic half to it by inattention.
_meta.schema: domains: [ { key, source: labs|wearables, genetic_half: bool, markers: [marker keys of lab_markers.json], why } ] — `key` is also the i18n key `radar.domain.<key>` and the top-level key of system_gene_panels.json; `markers` is empty for a wearables domain. panel_markers? (shown, never scored), derived? (ratios of provenance.DERIVED, shown, never scored).
_meta.order_matters: The order of the list is the order the radar draws its axes in and the order the previous stored radars used. Reordering is a visible change, not a cosmetic one.
_meta.why_a_marker_in_two_systems: Since 17.09.2026 a marker may count in the score of two systems: homocysteine in inflammation and in amino acids, uric acid and creatinine in the kidneys and in amino acids, C-reactive protein in inflammation and in immunity, vitamin D in vitamins and in the musculoskeletal system. Each system reads it for its own question. The first system in this file is the marker's home, where a single place is needed.

domains.why: The lipid panel as a laboratory issues it.

Heart and vessels: the cardiovascular-risk markers a laboratory issues beside the lipid panel — lipoprotein(a) and the two apolipoproteins — and the two coagulation markers, fibrinogen and D-dimer. Added 13.09.2026 by the owner's decision so that the pharmacogenetics of warfarin, clopidogrel, the beta-blockers, the anticoagulants and antiplatelets, and the cardiovascular polygenic scores have a system of their own. See _meta.why_cardio.
Carbohydrate metabolism. Insulin stays here, where HOMA-IR is computed from it — splitting an index from one of its two inputs would leave neither system able to explain it.
The thyroid panel a laboratory issues. One of the four endocrine systems that replaced «hormones» in 0.4.9 — see _meta.why_four_endocrine_systems.
The adrenal panel. One of the four endocrine systems of 0.4.9.
The gonadal panel. One of the four endocrine systems of 0.4.9.
The growth axis. One of the four endocrine systems of 0.4.9.

Both halves of the gland: the acinar cell that makes the digestive enzymes, and the beta cell, whose C-peptide is released with insulin in equal amount and survives long enough to be measured. Insulin itself stays in the carbohydrate panel, where HOMA-IR is computed from it, and is MARKED at the pancreas instead.

Immunity: the white cells and lymphocytes, immunoglobulin A, the inflammatory markers and the two autoantibody screens a laboratory issues for autoimmune disease. Added on the owner's decision of 17.09.2026 (task 199), with the clinicians agreeing to the system; its rheumatoid panel lands here. C-reactive protein also counts in inflammation: a marker may count in two systems.

The musculoskeletal system, read through bone and mineral metabolism: calcium, phosphorus, alkaline phosphatase, parathyroid hormone, osteocalcin and vitamin D. Added on the owner's decision of 17.09.2026 (task 199), with the clinicians agreeing to the system. Vitamin D also counts in vitamins: a marker may count in two systems.

Amino acids and protein: what feeds the body's own synthesis. The score is built from seven markers that mean something one by one; the amino acid panel and its ratios are shown beside it and never scored — a single amino acid says little on its own, and the panel is read as a picture. Homocysteine, uric acid and creatinine also count in inflammation and in the kidneys: a marker may count in two systems (owner, 17.09.2026). The panel outside its corridor enters the score as one term, so a drifting panel shows at the top level. The genetic half is composed from the gene–disease base and carries the authored positions of the chain: digestion and absorption, carriage into tissues, use inside the cell, renal losses.
Built from wearable metrics by `lifestyle()` and attached to the radar after the laboratory domains; it has no laboratory panel and no genetic half. See _meta.fitness.
